children.name: Stichodactyla gigantea
children.description: Stichodactyla gigantea, commonly known as the giant carpet anemone, is a species of sea anemone that lives in the Hawaii, USA, North America, and Indo-Pacific area.

children.name: Stichodactyla haddoni
children.description: Stichodactyla haddoni, commonly known as Haddon's sea anemone, is a species of sea anemone belonging to the family Stichodactylidae.

children.name: Stichodactyla helianthus
children.description: Stichodactyla helianthus, commonly known as the sea sunflower or sun anemone, is a sea anemone of the family Stichodactylidae.

children.name: Stichodactyla mertensii Brandt, 1835
children.description: Stichodactyla mertensii, commonly known as Mertens' carpet sea anemone, is a species of sea anemones in the family Stichodactylidae.

children.name: Stichodactyla tapetum
children.description: Stichodactyla tapetum, commonly known as maxi-mini carpet anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Stichodactylidae.

children.name: Radianthus crispa
children.description: The sebae anemone (Radianthus crispa), also known as leathery sea anemone, long tentacle anemone, or purple tip anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Stichodactylidae and native to the Indo-Pacific.

children.name: Radianthus magnifica
children.description: Radianthus magnifica, also known as magnificent sea anemone or Ritteri anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Stichodactylidae that is native to the Hawaii, USA, Indo-Pacific.

children.name: Radianthus malu
children.description: Radianthus malu, also known as the malu anemone, delicate sea anemone or white sand anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Stichodactylidae.
